description:
ORIGAMICS | Founding Researcher | San Francisco | ONSITE/REMOTE Origamics is building AI models that reason about electronics and help turn schematics into production-ready boards. We’re looking for a Founding Researcher to work directly with the founders on physics-informed models for Electronics design — physical behavior, simulation, and scientific ML. You’ll tackle open-ended research problems, push models from experiments to production and real hardware, and have the opportunity to publish novel research along the way. You’ll likely be a good fit if you have strong ML/research fundamentals, enjoy 0→1 problems, and have experience with scientific ML, geometric deep learning, numerical methods, simulation, EE, or applied physics. PhD is a plus, not a requirement. Apply: https://www.origamics.ai/join-us?ashby_jid=7acf3a2d-46a5-420... 
(Mention HN when applying.)
